title: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5), billed as its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model. It runs about 75% cheaper on average than Haiku 4.5 and is the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting. It suits summaries, classification, and database queries, and works as a subagent alongside Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, with Box reporting +11 points at about half the latency.

title: Agent observability on the Claude Platform
summary: The Claude Platform now exports OpenTelemetry traces from Managed Agents, the Messages API, and SDKs in public beta. Managed Agents and the Messages API need a destination configured in the Claude Console, while SDKs export automatically, and traces cover agent turns, model calls, and tool use with latency, token counts, and IDs. It follows OTel GenAI semantic conventions and works with Grafana Cloud, Datadog, Langfuse, Honeycomb, and any OTLP endpoint, supporting debugging, turning production traces into evals, and tracking org token usage.

title: How an Anthropic BDR in Japan runs his day with Claude Managed Agents
summary: A business development rep on Anthropic's Japan team describes running his workday with five scheduled agents on Claude Managed Agents (beta) handling lead routing, triage, draft replies, CRM updates, and meeting follow-ups, with a sixth coordinator agent updating the others. Rule-based work runs on Sonnet and judgment-heavy work on Opus, with agents sharing a memory store. He estimates about 60 hours saved, redirected to customer conversations and outbound strategy, and advises describing each job once, letting shared knowledge carry context, and delegating sooner.

title: Uber's CISO on building an insider threat program for AI
summary: Uber CISO Philip Martin explains how Uber is building an insider threat program that treats AI agents like insiders. Frontier models' larger context handling enables more specific threat models, and Uber pairs Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with its open-source AI Detection and Response tool and an LLM gateway while keeping control of its data and response decisions. Its priorities are real-time detection and intervention and feeding emerging model-behavior findings back into safeguards.

title: Code Review is now generally available
summary: Claude Code's automatic PR review is now generally available for Team and Enterprise. Reviews run about 3x faster than preview (roughly 6-10 minutes versus about 20), with more concise findings and more bugs that matter caught, and admins can set each repo to Quick, Standard (default), or Deep review. Eligible Enterprise orgs can claim at least $10,000 in credits by January 15, 2027.

title: Building effective agent automations
summary: Anthropic published a reference implementation of scheduled agents on Claude Managed Agents (beta), including a sample daily-brief agent that reads Slack and GitHub and posts a brief to Slack, with code in anthropics/claude-quickstarts. It guards against coverage gaps and repeats, silent source failures, duplicate posts, and date or time zone errors, using a cron schedule, a per-run budget cap, a read-only preferences store, and vaulted credentials. Users start with claude update and /claude-api managed-agents-onboard, though prompt injection in source text remains a caveat.
